picks.what: The Gutehoffnungshütte ironworks and the Eisenheim workers’ settlement, colored lithograph
picks.why: color general view of the works around which the town was founded in 1862

gaps: P0–P3: nothing (#1–#3 are replicas of a Frankfurt painting shown in the Gasometer, #4 is a plan of Schloss Sinning in Upper Bavaria); P5: only a 1925 house in Sterkrade, posters and a Rostock shipyard; P6: existing castle courtyard panorama kept
notes: #6 (colored postcard of the Gutehoffnungshütte blast furnaces, dated only ‘about 1900’) could be a second P4 view, but its date is loose and it is just 40 years from #7, so it was left out. #14 is the full version of the existing 2015 panorama; #13 is the Gasometer interior.
